journey.step1Body: This URL is needed for sync and server-side price data.
journey.step2Title: 2. Choose the target for Steam items
journey.step2Body: Small note: you can change this at any time in Settings.
journey.step3Body: The key is stored locally and encrypted only. Never in the web build and never on the server.
journey.step3Warning: Do not share the key. If you suspect a leak, delete the old key and create a new one. You can change the key at any time under Management.
journey.step4Body: During the import you see the loading state directly in the CSFloat sync dialog.
journey.step4Hint: If you import now, we take you straight to the matching step afterwards.
journey.step5Body: Browser push is meant for mobile. In Electron the built-in feed is enough, so it is best to enable push in the mobile companion.
journey.step5Recommendation: Recommendation: open the server on your phone, sign in, and enable browser push under Settings – General.
journey.step7Body: This is where you control matching, prices and exclude logic for your items.
